records.text: Bill Gay himself, a Mormon, attended the Croesus Day and night and in eight-hour shifts they were assisted by four physicians on 24-hour calls and five lesser functionaries including Gordon Margolis and Mel Stewart, it goes through the names here, for their services the six senior aides were paid as much as $110,000 a year each. They equipped his various hideaways, decided which messages would reach.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
